alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. The black one asks so, how was it? Three dots float over the blue one, which looks up with sleepy eyes while the black one waits with wide eyes and a small tremble. The black one says take your time. Then the blue one answers okay, so... and the black one's eyes go happy. Both settle back exactly as they started, so the film can repeat without a cut. The text stays: me letting the silence sit.
